## Derived performance summary

Latency is the median of three fresh process sweeps. Speedup = comparison backend latency / CuteDSL W4A16 latency; **>1 means W4A16 is faster**. Ratios use unrounded values.

- **TRTLLM MXFP8 versus TRTLLM BF16:** The speedup (TRTLLM BF16 latency / TRTLLM MXFP8 latency) ranges from 1.31× to 1.70× across the 39 configuration/token medians. TRTLLM MXFP8 is faster at every point.
- **Repeat variability:** the largest `(max − min) / median` among the three-sweep samples is 14.6%, for TRTLLM NVFP4 at 2 tokens (Inference per-token). All samples are retained; near-1× ratios should not be interpreted as decisive differences.
